description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' is a helper that wraps Android's native Log utility to implement a logging chain through 'LogNode' interfaces. It enables log messages to be forwarded through a chain of log nodes, thus facilitating flexible logging targets.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode interface that wraps Android's Log utility and forwards log messages to an optional next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message using Android's Log, appends stack trace if Throwable is provided, and forwards the message to the next LogNode if set.
